chunks: It is narrated from Abī Dharr, may Allah have mercy upon him, that he said:
I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, saying:
"Indeed, the animal says: O Allah, provide me with a truthful master who feeds me, gives me drink, and does not burden me with what I cannot bear."

key_terms.ارْزُقْنِي: grant me or provide for me
key_terms.الدَّابَّةَ: the animal or beast being cared for by a human owner
key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ: O Allah; a direct form of supplication
key_terms.يُشْبِعُنِي: feeds me until I am satisfied

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith teach about kindness and proper treatment of animals in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches mercy and ethical responsibility toward animals by portraying them as calling upon Allah for a caring and truthful owner. It emphasizes feeding, watering, and not overburdening animals, reflecting the Prophetic sunnah of compassion toward all living creatures.
